value.rationale: The sharp two-parameter law identifies a structurally distinct quadratic contact phase in a classical Legendre/binomial-square transform where the previously studied central weight exhibits cubic contact. It implies a complete geometric valuation spectrum and frequency law within a natural dyadic index cylinder, and the excluded preceding cylinder demonstrably fails. This is a motivated exact arithmetic invariant, not an arbitrary small-index calculation.
